headline: PHI @ NYM matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PHI 4.66 at NYM 3.88, with a projected total of 8.55. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward PHI: PHI moved +0.39 runs while NYM moved -0.41, changing the projected margin by +0.81 runs. NRFI probability rose +17.3%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Cionel Pérez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Carson Benge, Bryce Harper, Bo Bichette, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Brett Baty because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
